messages:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — planning to roll out SDK 6.0.0 + API compatibility shim (server-side) to staging at 14:00 UTC. Who's on call for deploy + smoke?
Liam Chen: I can take deploy window. Will be on standby 13:50–15:00 UTC.
Sofia Martinez: I'll run the integration smoke tests and client-compat checks.
Kenji Tanaka: I'll watch telemetry/alerts and be ready to rollback if error rates spike.
Maya Patel: Thanks. Major items: 1) forward-compatible endpoint responses (no breaking schema changes) 2) new optional field `response.meta.latency_est` 3) SDK patch that tolerates absent meta field.
Liam Chen: Rollout plan summary:
- deploy to staging (image tag: `infra/sdk-6.0.0-staging`)
- run smoke checklist (see below)
- promote to canary in prod (5% traffic) for 30m if green
- ramp to 25% → 50% → 100% with 15–30m observation windows
Sofia Martinez: Smoke checklist (I'll run):
1) curl API health: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/health` — expect `{"status":"ok"}`
2) sample generate + verify no schema break: `curl -sS -XPOST https://staging.api.../v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` and check `response.meta` is optional
3) run client regression tests (npm: `npm run ci:client-compat`) — must pass 95%+
4) run 5 long-running chat sessions to validate KV cache behavior (latency < 120ms p95)
5) confirm SDK backwards compatibility smoke harness: run `node tests/smoke/sdk-compat.js`
Kenji Tanaka: Observability checks I'll validate in parallel:
- error rate increase > 0.5% over baseline = pause
- 5xx count > 3 in 5m = rollback
- latency p95 up > +50ms = investigate
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: `infra/sdk-6.0.0-staging` -> staging at 2026-06-01T14:00:00Z.
Maya Patel: Client comms: Ava, can we publish a short note to #customer-updates outlining: what's new, compatibility, and recommended SDK upgrade path? Also include rollback instructions so clients know nothing to do if we revert.
Ava (Product Ops): Yep. Drafting now. I'll ping channel when ready. Will include code snippets and migration notes.
Liam Chen: Rollback plan (ready):
- revert k8s deployment to image tag `infra/sdk-5.9.3-prod` via `kubectl set image`
- toggle feature flag `sdk6_enabled` -> false in config service
- revert routing in gateway (if canary promotion completed)
- notify teams + run smoke tests again on reverted image
Maya Patel: Who will hit the rollback if needed?
Liam Chen: I'll initiate revert. Kenji will validate metrics after revert.
Sofia Martinez: ETA for smoke run after staging deploy — ~8–10 minutes. I'll post pass/fail in this thread.
Maya Patel: Awesome. If all green, we aim to start prod canary at 15:00 UTC. If anyone cannot make the window, please call out now. :thumbsup:
Kenji Tanaka: I'm good.
Ava (Product Ops): I'll queue the client note to go out after canary success.
Sofia Martinez: staging smoke started. posting logs in 5.
Sofia Martinez: staging smoke: integration tests 98% pass, sample generate returns with and without `response.meta` OK, latency p95 85ms.
Maya Patel: Nice. Proceed to prod canary at 15:00 UTC. Liam, kick it off when ready.
Liam Chen: Starting canary promotion (5%). Will monitor for 30m.
Kenji Tanaka: Watching dashboards. No error spike so far.
Sofia Martinez: Quick note — one client regression flagged in `legacy-auth` test but it's flaky and repros locally; I'm investigating.
Maya Patel: Keep thread updated. If it looks persistent >10m, halt promotion.
Liam Chen: Canary at 5% -> healthy -> promoted to 25% now.
deploy-bot: Canary promotion completed: 25% traffic.
Kenji Tanaka: Metrics stable. No 5xx. p95 latency +12ms.
Sofia Martinez: `legacy-auth` repro is unrelated to SDK change — rolling fix to test harness.
Maya Patel: OK going to 50% in 10m. If all green, full rollout after 30m watch.
Ava (Product Ops): Draft client note ready, will publish after 50% success.
Liam Chen: 50% -> stable. Proceed to 100%.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: SDK 6.0.0 compatible changes live at 2026-06-01T16:05:00Z.
Maya Patel: Thank you everyone. Postmortem light: if any post-release regressions pop up, add them to the rollout ticket and tag eng-platform. :party-parrot:
Sofia Martinez: All good from my side. Closing smoke task.
Kenji Tanaka: Monitoring for 1h then will drop off.
Maya Patel: Closing thread — final notes: update changelog, tag release in repo, and Ava will publish client-facing note.
Ava (Product Ops): Published note to customers and internal changelog. :white_check_mark:
